name: Swarmer Inc
summary: Swarmer, Inc. is dedicated to developing cutting-edge autonomous drone technology and comprehensive solutions. The company's primary focus areas encompass artificial intelligence, hardware simulation, and live video streaming, all specifically designed for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) operations. Swarmer offers AI-powered solutions that facilitate fully autonomous drone missions, with a strong emphasis on collaborative autonomy to minimize human involvement in high-risk environments. Their proprietary operating system is engineered to secure data storage, provide real-time status updates, and enable reliable video streaming from UAVs, ensuring consistent mission performance. Additionally, Swarmer delivers a sophisticated multi-level command and control system for managing diverse UAV fleets, allowing a single operator to integrate and manage multiple drones. The company further enhances UAV capabilities through advanced hardware simulation and robust video streaming functionalities. Swarmer's approach to drone autonomy is guided by core principles of transparency, dependability, and ethical AI. The company was founded in 2023 and is based in Wilmington, Delaware.
